muc.title: Copy, paste, fix all afternoon
muc.text: You ask Claude for a planning table, then spend all afternoon copying, pasting and fixing the formatting. There's a neater way: Artifacts.

muc.title: It opens right next to the chat
muc.text: An artifact is a finished piece that opens right next to the chat: a document, slides, a small spreadsheet, or even a tool you can click.

muc.title: Edit with words
muc.text: To change it, just say: add a notes column, make it blue. Or click in and edit it directly, like a text document.

muc.title: Download it or share a link
muc.text: When you're done, download it as Word, PDF or PowerPoint, or send a link for others to see. Artifacts are private by default, and you choose who can see them.

muc.title: Free or paid?
muc.text: The free plan can already create, edit and share. Ready-made templates like Docs, Slides and Design need a paid plan.

muc.title: A trip expense splitter
muc.text: Ask Claude to make a trip expense splitter for five people: enter the amounts and it works out how much each person pays. Then send the link to the group.

muc.title: Claude Design
muc.text: Want really nice slides or a landing page in your brand colors? Part 3: Claude Design.
